title: The Invisible Language Tax: Token Premiums of French and Regional Languages in 2026 LLM Tokenizers, and a French-Optimized Prototype

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the 'tokenization premium' by measuring the ratio of tokens required to encode identical translated content in non-English languages compared to English, using parallel corpora (such as NTREX-128 and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights) across various commercial LLM tokenizers.
